name: Bitcoin
evidence: genesis block timestamp 2009-01-03T18:15:05Z (blockstream.info); CoinGecko + CoinPaprika agree

name: Litecoin
evidence: genesis block timestamp 2011-10-07T07:31:05Z (litecoinspace.org). CoinGecko says 2011-10-08, which is off by a day

name: Dogecoin
evidence: genesis block timestamp 2013-12-06 10:25:40 (blockchair); CoinPaprika agrees. CoinGecko says 2013-12-08, which is off by two days

name: Ethereum
evidence: CoinGecko genesis_date and CoinPaprika started_at agree (genesis block itself carries timestamp 0, so on-chain can't be used)

name: Algorand
evidence: mainnet genesis block timestamp 2019-06-11 (algonode.cloud), matches the officially announced mainnet launch date

name: Tezos
evidence: mainnet genesis block timestamp 2018-06-30T16:07:32Z (tzkt.io), matches the officially announced mainnet launch date
